Author: bonkBANK, Infi, Anna
Name: Chat 2 (BonkChat)
Description:
Chat 2 is a complete rewrite of the in-game chat window as a plugin.
It supports:

- Unlimited tabs
- Tabs that always send to a certain channel
- More flexible filtering
- RGB channel colouring
- Completely variable font size
- Sidebar tabs
- Unread counts
- Emotes
- Screenshot mode (obfuscate names)
Punchline: Chat 2 fork with AI grammar correction to practice your English while you play.
Changelog:
**BonkChat 1.50.1**
- Fixed roleplay replies losing their *asterisks*: the output format
  rule said "no quotes", which models read as permission to strip the
  message's own formatting
- Wrapping is now restored in code when the original was wrapped, so it
  no longer depends on the model obeying the prompt
- Explicit tone now includes the evocative wording of Sensual instead
  of replacing it, so it no longer reads flatter than the level below

**BonkChat 1.50.0 - Roleplay Mode**
- A theatre-masks button next to the AI buttons toggles roleplay mode
  for that tab; the channel line shows [RP] while it is on
- Turning it on reveals a settings button: tone (Neutral / Sensual /
  Explicit), fixed pronouns for both characters, names, and a free
  text box for your own instructions
- Fixed pronouns stop the AI from switching between he and she mid
  scene, which no amount of context reliably fixes on its own
- Output keeps your *asterisks* and "quotes", writes third person
  present tense, mirrors the length of recent messages, and never
  invents actions you did not write
- Thai notes are skipped in this mode: less noise mid scene, and cheaper
- Settings live on the tab, so switching the mode off to chat normally
  and back on keeps that person's setup

**BonkChat 1.49.1**
- Pop-out tab windows now have the AI buttons, and Ctrl+G / Ctrl+T act
  on the input box you are actually typing in
- The suggestion panel appears above that window instead of the main one
- A pop-out uses its own tab's scene context, not the main window's tab

**BonkChat 1.49.0**
- Right click a player name -> "Create a tab for this player" makes a
  tab holding only your conversation with them, and switches to it
- Keeps the AI scene context clean: the context follows the tab, so a
  dedicated tab means no bystanders in your translations

**BonkChat 1.48.0 - Context, Custom Styles and the Usage Meter**
- Translations now see the recent conversation, so pronouns, tense and
  writing style stay consistent instead of being guessed per message
- The transcript is append-only and tagged with a conversation id, which
  is what xAI's prompt cache needs to bill most of it at the cheap rate
- Grok 4.3: reasoning is turned off by default (reasoning tokens are
  billed as output and translation does not need them)
- Custom rewrite styles: add your own tones next to Politer/Friendlier/Shorter
- Usage meter with real token counts, cached share, and a monthly budget
  that pauses requests when reached
- Reading mode can skip the Thai notes to keep replies short and cheap
- Context is configurable per mode; off for grammar correction by default

**BonkChat 1.47.0**
- New AI provider: Grok (xAI), using the Responses API
- Pick grok-4.5 or grok-4.3 with one click, or type any model name
- API key stored encrypted like the other providers

**BonkChat 1.46.0**
- Merged upstream Chat 2 updates: emotes now load from a bundled
  static list (fixes emotes after the BetterTTV API change)

**BonkChat 1.45.0**
- The AI panel is now a floating window above the chat box, so long
  suggestions no longer shrink the message log
- AI replies never contain emoji anymore (prompt rule + hard strip);
  the game chat cannot display them
- AI is instructed to avoid unnecessary exclamation marks
- Saved prompts matching an older default are upgraded automatically

**BonkChat 1.44.0 - Rewrite Styles**
- Right click the AI button to rewrite your message: Politer,
  Friendlier or Shorter, with Thai explanations of the tone changes
- Chain styles from the suggestion panel without applying in between
  (e.g. fix grammar, then make it politer, then shorter)
- "Restore original" moved into the same right-click menu
- Rewrite prompt is configurable in the AI settings tab

**BonkChat 1.43.0**
- AI API keys are now stored encrypted (Windows DPAPI, per-user);
  existing plain-text keys are encrypted automatically on load
- Background images can be cropped: the crop frame is locked to your
  current chat window size, drag to position and zoom to frame
- Works for both the global image and per-tab images

**BonkChat 1.42.2**
- AI responses are now cached (LRU, 200 entries): repeating the same
  request answers instantly without using API quota
- Cache size and a clear button in the AI settings tab

**BonkChat 1.42.1**
- Per-tab background images (set in Settings -> Tabs; falls back to
  the global image when a tab has none)
- Pop-out tab windows now draw their tab's background image
- Fixed pop-out height being reduced while the AI panel was open

**BonkChat 1.42.0**
- Right click any message -> "AI: Translate to Thai" with slang/vocab notes
- Custom background image for the chat window (Display settings):
  choose any image, adjust opacity, stretch or cover fit

**BonkChat 1.41.1**
- Keybinds for the AI features, configurable in the AI settings tab
- Default: Ctrl+G corrects grammar, Ctrl+T translates to English
- Both work while typing in the chat input

**BonkChat 1.41.0 - AI Learning Update**
- Grammar corrections now open a suggestion panel above the input box
- Changed words are highlighted, with short explanations in Thai
- New translate button: type Thai, get natural English for game chat
- Thai text rendering and Thai typing in the chat input
- Configurable prompts for both modes in the AI settings tab

**1.40.x**
- AI portal supporting ChatGPT (OpenAI), Gemini and SWU AI
- AI grammar correction button next to the chat input
- Based on Chat 2 by Infi & Anna
